task:
`bin/bump_version.sh <version> <major|minor|patch>` prints the bumped
semantic version, but `tests/run.sh` fails.

Required behaviour:
- A minor bump resets patch to 0; a major bump resets minor and patch to 0.
- An optional leading "v" is accepted and preserved in the output
  ("v1.2.3" patch -> "v1.2.4").
- The version must match X.Y.Z with non-negative integers; otherwise print
  an error to stderr and exit 2. An unknown part also exits 2.
- Exactly two arguments; anything else exits 2.
